items.note: και σωτηριας (kai sōtērias) 'and salvation' is only in traditional manuscripts (Tyn+Treg+TR+Byz)
ὑμῶν (humōn) 'you' occurs in a few manuscripts (Byz) instead of ἡμῶν. (hēmōn) 'us.' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg+TR)
ἁγιότητι (hagiotēti) '[the] holiness' occurs in a few manuscripts (Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg) instead of ἁπλότητι (haplotēti) 'openness' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+TR+Byz)
ἡμῶν (hēmōn) 'of us' is only in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+SBL+WH)
χαρὰν (charan) 'joy' occurs in a few manuscripts (WH) instead of χάριν (charin) 'grace' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+Treg+TR+Byz)
διὸ (dio) 'Therefore' is only in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
λοιποί (loipoi) 'rest' occurs in a few manuscripts (Byz) instead of πολλοὶ (polloi) 'many' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg+TR)
καρδίας (kardias) 'of a heart' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR) instead of καρδίαις (kardiais) 'of hearts' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg+Byz)
αὑτῶν (hautōn) 'yourselves' occurs in a few manuscripts (SBL+WH+Treg) instead of ἑαυτῶν, (he'autōn) 'ourselves,' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+TR+Byz)
κυρίου (kuriou) 'Lord' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
ἐνδυσάμενοι (endusamenoi) 'having put on' occurs in traditional manuscripts (Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg+TR+Byz) instead of ἐκδυσάμενοι (ekdusamenoi) 'having put off' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27)
τὰ πάντα. (ta panta) 'all things.' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
Ἰησοῦ (Iēsou) 'Jesus' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
Ὑμεῖς (Humeis) 'you yourselves' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of ἡμεῖς (hēmeis) 'We ourselves' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
ἐστε (este) 'you are' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of ἐσμεν (esmen) 'we are' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
ὑμᾶς, (humas) 'by you' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
ἀλλ᾽ (all᾽) 'but' is only in a few manuscripts (WH)
ὑμῶν (humōn) 'of you' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of ἡμῶν (hēmōn) 'of us' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
δέξασθαι ἡμᾶς, (dexasthai hēmas) 'to receive us,' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR)
ὑμῶν (humōn) 'of you' occurs in traditional manuscripts (Tyn+Treg+TR+Byz) instead of ἡμῶν (hēmōn) 'of us' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+SBL+WH)
ἡμῖν (hēmin) 'us' occurs in traditional manuscripts (Tyn+Treg+TR+Byz) instead of ὑμῖν (humin) 'you' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+SBL+WH)
ὑμῶν (humōn) 'of you' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR) instead of ἡμῶν. (hēmōn) 'of us.' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg+Byz)
τῆς καυχήσεως. (tēs kauchēseōs) 'of boasting.' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
καὶ τῆς ἁγνότητος (kai tēs hagnotētos) 'and the purity' is only in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
Χριστοῦ (Christou) 'Christ' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
θέλων, (thelōn) 'wishing' is only in traditional manuscripts (Tyn+TR+Byz)
δὴ (dē) 'indeed' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of δεῖ, (dei) 'it behooves [me],' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
συμφέρει (sumpherei) 'it is better' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of συμφέρον (sumpheron) 'is it profitable' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
μοι (moi) 'to me' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of μέν, (men) 'indeed,' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
μου· (mou) 'of mine;' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
Διὸ (Dio) 'Therefore' is only in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
μου (mou) 'of mine' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
καυχώμενος· (kauchōmenos) 'boasting;' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)

γράφω, (graphō) 'I am writing' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
εἰ (ei) 'if' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
Εὐχόμαι (Euchomai) 'I pray' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of εὐχόμεθα (euchometha) 'We pray' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
